An '''amplification dish''' was a weapons component used in [[Loronar Defense Industries]]' [[MAS-2xB]] as part of the [[turbolaser pulsor]]. The amplification dish surrounded the [[turbolaser actuator]] that was used to focus the weapon's energy beam.<ref name="EGWT" />
